# Lionel Fairlie

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Lionel Fairlie is a somewhat handsome and striking figure, described as a youthful colossus. He has a large head with a tall, pale forehead free of wrinkles, a thick mane of red hair that remains untouched by grey despite his age, and blue eyes. Across his wide chest cascades a long, reddish beard.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001)_

## Personality

Lionel Fairlie is a large, red-bearded, and self-satisfied man who is notable for his reclusive habit of never going out. Well-read and intelligent, he approaches courting openly and directly, without leaving anyone uncertain of his intentions. While he lacks malice in some respects and can be generous, his interactions with [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) fluctuate between bullying and coaxing as he remains determined to win her in the end. He also appreciates grit in others, though he expressly forbids weeping in females.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P61](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0061), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. ## History

Following a two-year companionship with [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), Lionel Fairlie deserted her in a sudden bout of resentment and hastily married [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) [Coyle](../character/coyle.md) out of spite. Years later, he berated [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) when she visited his residence, but her spirited confrontation won him over, prompting him to restore his financial support for her father's salary, resume attending church once a month, and drive her home. Later, after seeing [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) again, Lionel confronted her sister [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to ask that [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) be released from a past vow so they could marry, a request [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) granted.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P22](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "Indeed you are able to, girl, provided you employ your hearing. My sole intention was for you to feel at ease. You appear so blame uncomfortable, remaining on your feet like that. Oh well, I shall take a seat regardless."
>
> — Lionel Fairlie — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P6](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0006)

> "Let us engage in a friendly, sensible, and reasonable conversation. I need to inquire about a certain matter. Because Harriet refuses, the responsibility falls on me to ask."
>
> — Lionel Fairlie — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P8](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0008)

> "Your expression suggests you wish to speak but are afraid to do so. What is bothering you? Dammit, can you not speak out?"
>
> — Lionel Fairlie — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P32](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0032)

> "Though her condition was poor prior to her interment by me a decade back, her well-being has likely improved since"
>
> — Lionel Fairlie — [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P1](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0001)

> "Give me a spunky woman—spunk for me every time."
>
> — Lionel Fairlie — [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harriet-ainslie--lionel-fairlie.md)

Lionel Fairlie and [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) are rekindling an old courtship and have become engaged to be married. Lionel confronts Harriet's sister [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to release [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) from a vow so the marriage can take place, which [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) grants. However, tension remains as [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) firmly insists that she will not marry Lionel unless [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) agrees to live with them.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P11](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0011), +10 more_
